[[Blackburn Rovers FC (South Africa)|Blackburn Rovers]] | matches = 240 | total goals = 595 | average goals = 2.47 per match | league topscorer = [[David Zulu]] (16) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2012–13 National First Division|2012–13]] | nextseason = [[2014–15 National First Division|2014–15]] }} The '''2013–14 National First Division''' was played from September 2013 until May 2014, and is the second tier of South Africa's professional [[association football|football]]. [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]] won the league, earning promotion to the [[2014–15 South African Premiership|2014–15 Premiership]].{{Cite web |date=April 20, 2014 |title=Chippa United win PSL promotion as NFD champions |url=https://www.kickoff.com/sa-news/premiership/chippa-united-win-psl-promotion-as-nfd-champions-20140419 |access-date=2026-05-10 |website=Kick Off |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=2013/14 LOG – The NFD |url=https://thenfd.co.za/archive/201314/201314-log |access-date=1 March 2025 |website=thenfd.co.za}} [[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] and [[Milano United F.C.|Milano United]] finished second and third, thus qualifying for the promotion/relegation play-offs against [[Polokwane City F.C.|Polokwane City]], which had finished 15th in the [[2013–14 South African Premiership|Premiership]]. Polokwane City won the play-off, retaining the Premiership place. [[Roses United F.C.|Roses United]] and [[Blackburn Rovers FC (South Africa)|Blackburn Rovers]] were relegated to the [[SAFA Second Division|ABC Motsepe League]] following their 15th and 16th-place finishes. ==League table== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=PR |team1=CHU|name_CHU=[[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]] |team2=BLA|name_BLA=[[Black Leopards F.C.|Black Leopards]] |team3=MIL|name_MIL=[[Milano United F.C.|Milano United]] |team4=BAR|name_BAR=[[Baroka F.C.|Baroka]] |team5=SAN|name_SAN=[[Santos F.C.
